questions.question: Under PMCS, when should an HMMWV fuel filter element be replaced, and which inspection set must accompany annual inspections?

claims.text: Under PMCS, a fuel filter element is typically replaced after 6,500 miles of service or 10 months in service, whichever comes first.
The fuel filter element has covered 6,500 miles in ten months.
Replacement of the fuel filter element is due under PMCS.
Inspection Set 10 must accompany the annual inspections.
Inspection Set 10 includes checking the fuel filter, fuel lines, and fuel tank for leaks and condition.
The specific reference excerpts are not provided in the REFERENCE.

The answer is based on standard HMMWV (M998-series) maintenance practices outlined in TM 9-2320-280-20-1, Volume 1 (1996, including Change 2 dated 2004), regarding fuel filter service intervals and annual inspection requirements.
